notes: Group B re-check of 8 stored IT vendors, own sites only. Food-truck tools with a stated price: Qromo and Software Food Good are solid; MenuForma and Tilby are weak (see their notes), so no extra search for new food-truck tools was needed. Changes vs stored: Qromo flipped from not_relevant to eligible (Pro plan includes 'Delivery e asporto da Menù', pizzerie page describes 'ritiri programmati', food trucks named); DineEasy set to not_relevant (QR scan-and-order only, no ordering ahead on its pages). xMenu SETTLED as keep (nearest_local): 'La tua App per asporto e delivery' and 'Ecommerce per ordini online', but no pickup-time wording, so ahead is partial. Ordinalo WhatsApp Automation corrected: +19 EUR/month add-on (stored 1,900 was 100x). Ordinalo DELIVERY 82.50/month is the billed-yearly figure (990 EUR/year). Qromo's two figures per plan (49/59, 99/119) are assigned to yearly/monthly billing by inference from the toggle and the 240 EUR saving.
